commands.runner: BATCH_SPEC=experiments/actor-smoke-spec.json TRAJECTORY_DIR=output/actor-smoke-trajectories ORACLE_DIR=output/actor-smoke-oracle PROJECT_ROOT=. TASK_ENV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:19080 DIAGNOSER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:19081 RECOVERY_URL=http://127.0.0.1:19082 REPLAYER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:19084 python services/agent_runner/app.py
commands.evaluator: docker compose --profile analysis run --rm -T -v output/actor-smoke-trajectories:/data/trajectories -v output/actor-smoke-oracle:/data/oracle evaluator

note: Docker 镜像重建因 registry 网络超时未执行；smoke 使用当前工作区代码启动的独立本地服务，且通过当前源码运行、actor hash、轨迹/manifest 和健康端点校验。
